pages.title: Backrooms Craft
pages.creator: Superec Games
pages.description:
Backrooms Craft combines first-person exploration with block mining, crafting, and survival. Break apart the walls, floors, and furniture of the Backrooms to gather materials, then make tools, weapons, torches, and a shelter. Search poolrooms, offices, server halls, and warehouses while watching your health, hunger, and torch power. Some creatures follow you, and only construction inside the starting zone is retained.

Move with WASD, jump with Space, run with Shift, and crouch with C. E opens the inventory and J the journal. Hold the left mouse button to mine; right-click to place blocks or use items. Touch controls provide movement and action pads.

pages.title: Bike Games: Stunt Bike Racing
pages.creator: Nexifie L.L.C
pages.description: Bike Games: Stunt Bike Racing is a side-view motorcycle race with ramps, obstacles, and armed rivals. Hold the Race button to accelerate, then use separate buttons for front flips, back flips, nitro, and missiles. Reach the finish ahead of the other riders while using stunts and attacks to your advantage. Completed levels earn rewards for unlocking bikes and improving their performance.

pages.title: Latutu Holiday Gift Hunt
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Latutu Holiday Gift Hunt is a matching puzzle played with a pile of holiday toys and presents. Click or tap an item to put it into a slot, then gather three identical items there to clear the trio and score points. Keep freeing slots as you search the pile: filling every slot or running out of time ends the game.

pages.title: Tiny Baker Rainbow Buttercream Cake
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Tiny Baker Rainbow Buttercream Cake takes you through making a layered rainbow cake. Use the mouse to mix the ingredients, bake the cake, and add buttercream frosting. Finish by choosing decorations for the colorful dessert, working through the baking and decorating stages in order.

pages.title: Koko Loco Block Blast
pages.creator: Tarmar Dreams
pages.description: Koko Loco Block Blast asks you to fit block shapes onto a grid while keeping room for the next placements. Drag shapes into position with the mouse or touch input, clear blocks, and build combinations to raise your score. Plan how each shape uses the remaining space so the board does not fill up.

pages.title: Squid Game: Playground Shooter
pages.creator: GeekPlay
pages.description: Squid Game: Playground Shooter is a ragdoll shooting game about taking down all the characters in a scene. Try different guns and their shot effects, using explosions, traps, and interactive objects to send targets tumbling. Accurate shots earn coins, and each level presents another arrangement of characters and objects to clear.

pages.title: Kingdom Cats
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Kingdom Cats has you help the King of Cats build a kingdom through tapping and resource production. Tap to make residents construct the city, then improve its buildings to speed development and attract more workers. Make waffles to help the workers gather more stone, and send builders into the mine for ore. Process the mined material into jewelry, pack the goods into chests, and sell them to fund further growth.

pages.title: Mahjong Connect Fish World
pages.creator: wavegame
pages.description: Mahjong Connect Fish World is an ocean-themed tile-linking puzzle. Select two matching mahjong tiles with the mouse or touch controls to connect and remove them. Clear pairs as you work through the levels and uncover more of the underwater setting and its marine creatures.

pages.title: Gravity Speed Run
pages.creator: atupdev
pages.description: Gravity Speed Run sends you running along vertical walls rather than the ground. Move up and down to avoid obstacles and head-on collisions while progressing through the levels. Use touch or mouse input to control those movements, reacting to the hazards along the wall.

pages.title: Super Rock Climber
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Super Rock Climber is a third-person climbing challenge about reaching the summit. Guide the climber over difficult terrain and obstacles, trying to improve the time taken to reach the top. On a computer, use the left and right mouse buttons; on a phone, tap the corresponding halves of the screen.

pages.title: Backgammon Deluxe Edition
pages.creator: Monstera Games
pages.description: Backgammon Deluxe Edition has you move pieces around a board according to dice rolls. Compete with a friend, choosing how to use each turn's available movement. Bring all of your pieces around the board and bear them off before the other player to win.

pages.title: Dynamons 9
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description:
Dynamons 9 is a monster-collecting adventure set in a Halloween world and a bonus cave. Find creatures such as Tholanyx, Scarykin, and Anubolt, alongside special costume versions of other Dynamons, and recruit them for your team. Battles are turn-based, with one creature facing another.

Use action cards to attack and capture an opponent after weakening it. The backpack gives access to collected battle items, while shards raise your Dynamons' levels and unlock further action cards. Choose moves with mouse or touch input as you challenge other trainers and develop your collection.

pages.title: BFF Happy Spring
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: BFF Happy Spring helps Belle, Tiana, and Moana prepare for a party welcoming spring. Browse their cherry-blossom-inspired wardrobe and choose an outfit for each princess. Use left mouse clicks to try the available clothing and put together the friends' party looks.

pages.title: School Bus Game Driving Sim
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: School Bus Game Driving Sim puts you on a city school-bus route, picking children up and taking them between home and school. Complete the transportation duty on time while driving safely through the streets and highways. Drive with WASD or the arrow keys, use Space for the handbrake, C to change the camera, and H for the horn. P pauses the game.

pages.title: Dungeon Chess
pages.creator: Dev Hub Games
pages.description: Dungeon Chess combines card choices with movement on a small dungeon board. Select a card showing a chess piece, then choose where to move your hero using that card. Work around enemies and their abilities as you solve the tactical situations. The game brings roguelike elements to these compact chess-inspired encounters.

pages.title: Treating Mia Back Injury
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Treating Mia Back Injury puts you in the role of a doctor helping Mia after a road accident. Use the mouse to carry out the care activities for her injured back. After treating the injuries, choose an outfit to finish the character's recovery and makeover sequence.

pages.title: BFF Summer Shine Look
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: BFF Summer Shine Look gets a group of friends ready for a weekend resort party. Browse a fresh collection of summer outfits and pick a look for each friend. Add matching accessories and choose hairstyles to complete their party preparations. Use the left mouse button to make selections.

pages.title: Blocku Golf
pages.creator: Vally Games
pages.description: Blocku Golf challenges you to send a ball into the hole across increasingly difficult levels. Press on the screen and pull back in the direction opposite the shot, then release to launch. The length of the drag determines the shot's strength. Use a mouse or a finger to judge the direction and power needed for each course.

pages.title: Immense Army
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description:
Immense Army is an idle strategy game about expanding a force to defeat goblin armies. Recruit units automatically by improving their buildings, or click unit icons to recruit faster. Spend resources on soldiers' damage and health, better buildings, and a stronger gold mine.

Choose a battle from the map after checking the opposing army's power. Your units fight automatically, but clicking enemies adds damage. Collect treasure and mine gold to keep developing the army for the next confrontation.

pages.title: We're Impostors : Kill Together
pages.creator: Bin Studio
pages.description: We're Impostors : Kill Together has you coordinate red and blue impostors through a spaceship full of crewmates and traps. Switch between the characters and bring them close to targets to attack with knives. Their hazards differ: red must stay out of water, while blue must avoid fire. Use the arrow keys to move and the Swap button to change characters. Gather diamonds along the way to unlock skins.

pages.title: Super Lule Adventure
pages.creator: rungames.org
pages.description: Super Lule Adventure sends Super Lule through five worlds to rescue Princess Lili from a castle. Overcome enemies and obstacles on the way to the princess, working through the adventure's platforming challenges. Use the arrow keys to move, jump, and duck as you guide the hero onward.

pages.title: Pong the Ball
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Pong the Ball is a color-matching reflex puzzle with a ball bouncing vertically between two rows. Adjust the balls in the upper and lower rows so the moving ball meets its own color at each end. Its color changes randomly, so watch for the next change and update the match quickly. Tap the screen to play.

pages.title: 8 Ball Pro
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: 8 Ball Pro is a pool game against the computer or a friend. Pocket all the balls assigned to you, then sink the black 8 ball to win. Aim the cue and drag back before releasing to take a shot. Touch controls let you rotate the cue with a finger and use the same drag-and-release action to strike.

pages.title: Sports Bike Racing
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description:
Sports Bike Racing offers Parkour, Drift-X, and Time Trial modes across city, port, off-road, and airport locations. Choose from ten motorcycles with different handling and acceleration characteristics, then ride through the selected challenges. Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive and Space to brake.

Improve the engine, turbo, tires, transmission, and suspension, or personalize the bike with paint, rim colors, vinyls, lighting, and metal finishes.

pages.title: Jumping Joe
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Jumping Joe is a platform game about collecting stars and reaching the exit. Click or tap to make Joe jump through the level, and find the key needed to open the door. Reach that door to continue to the next stage while gathering the stars along the route.

pages.title: Pong Ball
pages.creator: Best Kids Games
pages.description: Pong Ball challenges you to make a falling ball meet another ball of the same color. Move the colored balls into position using the mouse or touch input, adjusting the arrangement before the next contact. Keep making correct color matches to build a higher score.

pages.title: Coloring Dolfje Weerwolfje
pages.creator: WPG Kindermedia
pages.description: Coloring Dolfje Weerwolfje lets you color illustrations of the character using several drawing modes. Choose a pencil and colors from the lower-right corner, then draw freely, keep coloring within the outlines, or fill areas automatically. You can download or print the pages to continue coloring on paper or display the finished pictures.

pages.title: Race The Traffic
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Race The Traffic puts you in a car weaving between other road users. Choose a vehicle and drive with WASD or the arrow keys, steering through the traffic ahead. Change its paint and rims, and improve handling, acceleration, and braking to develop the car as well as its appearance.

pages.title: Birds Connect Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Birds Connect Deluxe is a bird-themed tile-linking puzzle with fifteen levels. Select matching tiles and connect them along a route with at most two bends, removing pairs until the board is clear. Use the left mouse button or touch input to choose the birds. Finish quickly to earn the available time bonus.

pages.title: Letters Parts
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Letters Parts is an alphabet puzzle about recognizing an unfinished letter. Look at the missing section and click the piece that completes its shape. Work through the letters by matching their fragments, using the outlines to decide which piece belongs in each gap.

pages.title: Stickman Sports Badminton
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Stickman Sports Badminton offers matches for one or two players. Face the computer on Normal or Hard difficulty, or play against a friend. Pickups can provide a larger racket, fireballs, or extra speed, while negative effects can slow you down. Player one moves and jumps with WASD and swings with Space; player two uses the arrow keys and M to swing.

pages.title: Cute Girl Diamond Hunt
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Cute Girl Diamond Hunt has you guide Dora through jumps to gather diamonds. Use mouse or touch input to keep her moving between safe landing points and collect as many gems as possible. Watch the gaps as you jump: falling into space ends the attempt.

pages.title: Sweet Mia Dress Up
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Sweet Mia Dress Up gives you a wide selection of options for Mia's appearance. Change her hair, eyes, lip and nail colors, then choose clothing such as dresses, shirts, and jeans with shoes to match. Use mouse or touch input to try the combinations. Once the look is complete, view her in a scene and take a picture of Mia.

pages.title: Beetle capture
pages.creator: Vladimir Lysykh
pages.description: Beetle capture is a cookie-defense game in which robots try to take the treats. Click the robots to crush them before they can grab the cookies. Keep targeting the intruders to protect the food.

pages.title: Disk King
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Disk King is a disc-throwing contest about striking the opponent's blocks. Use the mouse to flick the disc toward the targets and take part in the competition. Judge the direction of each throw to hit the blocks in front of you.

pages.title: Clouds And Stars
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Clouds And Stars asks you to gather stars from between the clouds before the level's timer expires. Work through nine levels, using mouse or touch input to collect the targets. Each stage includes an hourglass that adds time, giving you longer to finish gathering the stars.

pages.title: 4ElementMaster
pages.creator: Ivan sac
pages.description: 4ElementMaster is a tower-defense game about stopping enemies from crossing your territory. Use the mouse to position towers along their route and build a defensive arrangement that prevents them from passing.

pages.title: Glamorous Princesses
pages.creator: Game-Devs
pages.description: Glamorous Princesses is a makeover game about getting ready for a gala. Try different hairstyles, clothing, shoes, and bags, then add jewelry and makeup to complete the look. Use clicks or taps to browse the options and coordinate the character's party appearance.

pages.title: Skeleton Party Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Skeleton Party Hidden asks you to search party pictures for concealed stars. Click or tap the stars you find to mark them and increase the found count. Locate every hidden star before the timer expires, then continue to the next scene. Study the picture's details carefully as you search for the remaining targets.

pages.title: Modern Train Driving Simulator: City Train Games
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Modern Train Driving Simulator: City Train Games puts you in control of a train with passenger, cargo, and practice options. Drive along the routes and complete the selected level, managing the train's speed on the way. Watch for prompts asking you to slow down and sound the horn, and use the camera controls to change your view.

pages.title: Frosch
pages.creator: Kostenlose Spiele
pages.description: Frosch challenges you to guide animals across a road without being hit. Move around obstacles and keep making successful crossings to improve your score. Choose from several characters and control them with WASD or the arrow keys. Press Tab or Escape to pause the game.

pages.title: Gelandewagen Simulator
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Gelandewagen Simulator lets you drive an off-road vehicle in a three-dimensional simulation. Use WASD or the arrow keys to control the vehicle, and interact with the on-screen buttons using the mouse.

pages.title: Space Crash
pages.creator: Vedia Games
pages.description: Space Crash is a ship-routing reflex game about preventing collisions. Click or tap a spacecraft to turn it around before it hits another ship or an asteroid. Keep watching the different routes and change directions as needed to keep the space travelers alive.

pages.title: FZ FoosBall
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: FZ FoosBall brings table football to a match against the computer or a second player. Control the rows of players to strike the ball toward the opposite goal while defending your own. Use A and D together with the Up and Down arrow controls to play the table, and score goals to win the contest.

pages.title: Maths Solving Problems
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Maths Solving Problems presents arithmetic questions using addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Work out each example and use the mouse to answer. The challenges draw on number calculations and multiplication-table knowledge as you solve the problems.

pages.title: City Car Racing Simulator 3D
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: City Car Racing Simulator 3D puts you behind the wheel for racing and drifting on city streets. Choose a car and drive along the asphalt roads, practicing how to handle it through the turns. Take part in the city-driving challenges with the vehicle you select.

pages.title: Halloween Where Is My Zombie?
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Halloween Where Is My Zombie? combines a Halloween theme with a line-drawing golf puzzle. Drag to draw a route that guides the ball into the hole, working through forty levels. Collect coins along the way and use them to unlock other Halloween ball designs.

pages.title: Halloween Memory
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Halloween Memory is a card-matching game featuring Halloween characters. Click or tap cards to uncover their pictures, then find the identical pairs. Remember the positions of the characters you have already seen so you can make the next match.

pages.title: Super Hard Boss Fighter
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Super Hard Boss Fighter puts KIZ against ten bosses threatening Earth. Fight the monsters and improve the hero's equipment as you progress. Upgrade weapons and character abilities, and buy a force field to help with the battles. Use mouse or touch controls to play through the boss encounters.

pages.title: Magic Cube
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Magic Cube is a three-dimensional twisty-cube puzzle. Drag to turn layers and rotate the cube, working to give every face a single color. Start a scrambled puzzle and solve it against the timer, with statistics recording completed solves and best times. Settings let you change the scramble length, color scheme, camera style, and turning animation.

pages.title: Jellys World
pages.creator: yupiy
pages.description: Jellys World follows a jelly creature traveling around a small planet and absorbing other jellies. Change its color to match the next object it meets, since only matching colors can be collected. Keep making the right changes to absorb more jellies and increase the score.

pages.title: Ill Billy
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Ill Billy asks you to choose between one and three fish at a time while avoiding a particular fish. Picking Ill Billy causes you to lose. Consider how many fish to select as you try to leave the dangerous choice untouched.

pages.title: Drag'n'Boom Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Drag'n'Boom Online lets you guide a young dragon over castles while attacking enemies and stealing gold. Aim the flight direction, burn targets, and collect coins to spend on upgrades. Watch for enemies and spikes as you move through the route. Play with mouse or touch controls while building the dragon's treasure.

pages.title: EG House Cleaning
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG House Cleaning is a dollhouse-organizing game about putting furnishings in the right rooms. Place the household pieces where they belong, matching items to suitable positions around the house. Work through the layout so each room contains the furniture and fixtures intended for it.

pages.title: Crazy Shooters
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Crazy Shooters is a multiplayer first-person shooter built around weapon-based room battles. Create a room and choose from maps such as Factory, Arena, Towers, and GasPlant. Room options include different weapon selections, including sniper, machine-gun, and pistol play. Fight other players with the equipment available in the chosen setup.

pages.title: Princess Perfect Christmas
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess Perfect Christmas has you help a princess prepare her home and outfit for the holiday. Decorate the rooms and Christmas tree, then choose clothing from the themed dress-up items.

pages.title: Ouija Voices
pages.creator: Paradine
pages.description: Ouija Voices is a virtual Ouija-board game that responds to spoken questions. Use your voice to ask the board something and wait for the game's answer.

pages.title: Chuck Chicken Memory
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Chuck Chicken Memory is a matching-card game featuring Chuck, Flick, Wing, and other characters from the animated series. Find identical cards and complete the matches as quickly as possible. Remember the pictures and their positions to reduce the time spent searching for the remaining pairs.

pages.title: Basket Ball Run
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Basket Ball Run challenges you to launch a ball from one basket into the next. Drag to set the direction and power, use the displayed arc to judge the shot, and release to throw. Successful baskets advance the course. Clean shots and rebounds can add scoring bonuses as you try to beat your best run.

pages.title: Exotic Wedding Looks
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Exotic Wedding Looks lets you design wedding outfits inspired by Indian, Chinese, and African styles. Create dresses and coordinate the bridal appearance, changing the character's hairstyle, eyes, and skin color.

pages.title: Rachel Winter Party Prep
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Rachel Winter Party Prep helps Rachel finish getting ready for her winter celebration. Choose makeup and a dress to complete the preparations she has already made.

pages.title: Daddy Spa Time
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Daddy Spa Time puts you in charge of a tired father's visit to a spa. Clean his face, add a little makeup, and carry out the pedicure activities.

pages.title: Exotic Princess Realife Shopping
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Exotic Princess Realife Shopping combines collecting money with choosing clothes. Help the princess gather bills, then take a cab to the store and see what the earnings can buy. Try tops, bottoms, dresses, and shoes. If another purchase costs too much, return to work and collect more money before shopping again. Tap to play through the activities.

pages.title: Shuigo
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Shuigo is a connect-two puzzle about finding matching images. Use the mouse to choose a pair of identical tiles that are close enough to connect, then remove the pair.

pages.title: Color Valley
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Color Valley challenges you to bounce a colored ball through rotating obstacles. Click or tap to move upward, passing only through sections that match the ball's current color. Touching a different color ends the run. Collect stars to raise your score and pass color switches to change the ball before the next obstacle.

pages.title: Design Your Monster High Backpack
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Design Your Monster High Backpack lets you personalize a backpack with colors and themed decorations. Paint its sections and add Monster High characters and toys to create your own design.
